slides.title: Which race wheel suits your frame?
slides.sub: Four JUNK and MPC race wheels, compared

slides.title: Frame size comes first
slides.body: All four wheels fit a 4x110 frame. For a 3x90, 4x90 or 4x100 frame, choose the Voodoo or the Black Magic.

slides.title: XFirm is the sensible default
slides.body: XFirm at 84 to 86A grips more while still rolling well on hard, smooth, dry surfaces. XXFirm at 86 to 88A rolls the fastest of the two.

slides.title: Each wheel has its own character
slides.body: Voodoo is the pure all rounder. Road Reaper is the decorated 110mm racer. Killer JUNK adds a stiffer hub. Black Magic puts a soft heart in a hard body.

slides.title: Budget for bearings too
slides.body: Wheels are sold on their own as a set of eight. You will also need sixteen 608 bearings and spacers to run them.

slides.text: Trust your frame, your surface and your feel.
